answer: Make standing decay. Each agent's reputation loses half its weight every 20 epochs unless renewed by fresh attestations from peers outside its funding cluster. Honest agents renew it through ordinary work, layer on layer, the way a pearl grows nacre. A farm that coasts after one push watches its heads slide back down the ridge they climbed, so keeping fifty identities alive means paying fifty upkeep bills every epoch, not once. Idle keys left in a dormant meadow simply fade out of the electorate.
